findings.correction: Even a D-rank probably wouldn’t have to live like this, but F-ranks like us had no other choice.
findings.current: Even an E-rank Hunter probably wouldn’t have to live like this, but people like us at F-rank had no other choice.
findings.defect: The cited Hunter rank is D, not E. That is a scene fact, and it also collides with the Team Leader later being an E-rank who is still broke.
findings.rationale: Source says D급만 되어도. The Team Leader is an E-rank with three kids and money trouble; D is the rank that would change that life.
findings.source: D급만 되어도 이렇게 살지는 않을 텐데, 우리 같은 F급들은 별수 없다.

findings.correction: Despite saying things like that, he was a famous devoted husband and a good father.
findings.current: Despite saying things like that, he was a famous henpecked husband and a good father.
findings.defect: 애처가 is a devoted, wife-loving husband. Henpecked is 공처가 and reverses the characterization under the swamp talk.
findings.rationale: The joke is that he calls marriage a swamp while being known for doting on his wife, then looking fondly at family photos.
findings.source: 말은 저렇게 해도 소문난 애처가에 좋은 아빠다.

findings.defect: The line comments on today being easy, not on whether raids are always easy.
findings.rationale: 오늘 marks this raid; always recasts a one-day observation as a habit.

findings.correction: He looked down at me with an indifferent gaze.
findings.current: He looked down at me with a calm expression.
findings.defect: 덤덤한 시선 is a detached, indifferent gaze. Calm expression loses the coldness of the accusation that follows.
findings.rationale: The betrayal beat is the lack of feeling, not composure, before “You, who ran away.”

findings.defect: 몫까지 살다 means live his share of life as well, not merely live for his sake.
findings.rationale: Wipeng’s counsel is to carry the dead man’s remaining portion of life, which the later path/dream talk continues.

findings.correction:
I remembered the old man from the meeting a few days ago, the one who had threatened to shove a giant needle into the White Tiger Hall Leader’s anus.

*So he really had been praying for me to die.*
findings.current:
I remembered the old man from the meeting a few days ago, the one who had threatened to shove a giant needle into the White Tiger Hall Leader’s anus.

*He really was chanting prayers for the man to die.*
findings.defect: 죽으라고 points at Taekyung after the “won’t last the day” diagnosis. “The man” attaches the death wish to the White Tiger Hall Leader.
findings.rationale: The medical verdict is that Taekyung would not survive the day; the meeting anecdote identifies the same old man, not a wish for the White Tiger Hall Leader’s death.
findings.source: 며칠 전 회의 때 백호당주의 항문에 대침을 꽂아 넣겠다고 하던 늙은이가 생각났다. 아주 죽으라고 염불을 외웠구나.

findings.correction: These clumps of mana possessed by monsters were high-dimensional energy, and the most valuable of all a monster’s byproducts.
findings.current: These clumps of magical power possessed by monsters were high-dimensional energy sources—and the most valuable of all a monster’s byproducts.
findings.defect: In the Hunter-system half of the book, 마력 is mana, not generic magical power.
findings.rationale: Binding terminology: mana for the modern Hunter system when the source uses that energy vocabulary.
findings.source: 몬스터가 지닌 이 마력 덩어리는 고차원 에너지인 동시에 몬스터의 부산물 중 가장 값진 거다.

findings.correction: “I saw you sleeping earlier, even breaking into a cold sweat.”
findings.current: “I saw you sleeping earlier. You were sweating cold enough to soak your clothes.”
findings.defect: Adds soaking clothes. The source only has sleeping while breaking into a cold sweat; the damp back comes later in narration.
findings.rationale: 식은땀까지 흘려 가면서 자던데 does not mention soaked clothes; 등허리가 축축하다 is a later, separate observation.

findings.correction: About twenty goblins threw poison needles, axes, and spears
findings.current: More than twenty goblins threw poison needles, axes, and spears
findings.defect: 이십여 is about twenty, not more than twenty.
findings.rationale: 여 marks an approximate count, not a floor above twenty.
findings.source: 이십여 마리의 고블린이 독침과 도끼, 창을 투척했지만

summary: Rank, kinship-characterization, and several action/advice beats are altered; D-rank becomes E-rank, 애처가 becomes henpecked, and the Team Leader’s indifferent gaze and “live his share” counsel are softened or recast.
